# Audit Report — iter 19 @ 5b4fcc75 (5th consecutive window at identical head)

## Evidence
- `git log --oneline -2`: HEAD unchanged (`5b4fcc75`). **Zero commits across iterations 14–19.** Only repo delta is the self-tick ledger `.pi-glla/active.jsonl`.
- `?? audit/LOOP-AUDIT-LIVE-VERIFY-2026-09-10.md` / `git ls-files … NOT-TRACKED`: the one-line fix flagged by audits at iters 13, 15, 16 and 17 still not executed.
- Audit health has continued to decay since last window: seeds grow monotonically (`160K → 172K → 180K`), newest completed job `mtwvypcb` died with `"Auditor stalled — no session activity for 20m while no auditor tool was running, so it was aborted."`; ledger verdicts remain `infra` every iteration since 12. No `loop_stop` events.

## Judgment
No new work this window — pure idle self-ticks on an unchanged tree, with the loop's own auditing mechanism slowly dying (unbounded resume-seed growth → stalls/aborts → no verdicts → steering never lands). Real feature work is done and verified in earlier windows, but progress toward "complete loops / works as intended" is stalled at the finish line and degrading. Not impossible to satisfy: code functions, one file is uncommitted, and the seed-growth failure mode is fixable with a small capped-seed change.

## Required fixes
- Next iteration, do this **first and unconditionally** (do not wait for an audit verdict — your audits have recorded only `infra` since iter 12): `git add audit/LOOP-AUDIT-LIVE-VERIFY-2026-09-10.md && git commit -m "docs(audit): live verification note for 0.38.43 loop auditor"`; gate: `git ls-files | grep LOOP-AUDIT` must print the path.
- Diagnose verdict starvation with one command: `tail -c 2000 .pi-glla/audit-jobs/mtwx7rau-*/session.jsonl` (and the last line's token/usage record) — if the ever-growing inspection-resume seed (88K→180K, no ceiling) is starving the auditor, add a minimal cap on seed size or resume-generation count in the inspection-resume path with one unit test; pick whichever change is smaller.
- If audits still die after that fix, this is auditor-model capacity, not code: raise/switch `auditorModel` in settings rather than patching source; then finish the loop (`/loop stop`) — further ticks on an unchanged tree yield nothing.
